protocol_records:
record_id: A124-P003
title: 光片成像、血管图像描迹与 SCN 分支密度分析
record_type: readout_and_analysis_procedure
purpose: 对透明固定脑的血管连续性及 core/shell 分支密度进行三维观察与分析。
applicability: 
  input: P001 所得固定标记透明脑
  panel_scope: Figs.1–4 and Supplementary Figs.1–5b/c as individually specified
  exclude: Supplementary Fig.5a 共聚焦独立支线；Fig.5 示意图不是独立采集流程。
start_state: 已经透明化的免疫标记脑，或其已取得的光片图像。
end_state: 图像、血管描迹、分区节点密度及配对统计。
provenance: 
  source: F01 Sec16–20; F03; F04; F05
  legacy_protocol_rows: 
[]
materials: 
  [1] Ultramicroscope II/Andor Neo sCMOS
  [2] LVMF-Fluor or PLAN xDISCO objective by source case
  [3] Imaris; Vesselucida 360; Vesselucida Explorer; R; ggplot2
preparation_and_warnings: 
  [1] 只有输入图像时从对应分析步骤开始；不为分析再执行组织透明化或重复采集。
  [2] 静态描迹和多个视角不证明血流方向或分子运输。
  [3] 整 SCN 与 Kirst 的外部描述性比较没有充分计算/取样说明，保留为参考性未完整方法，不将其并入本配对分析。
sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A124-P003-SEC01
    title: 采集与图像处理
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A124-P003-S01
        title: 光片装载与按范围采集
        action: 将已透明且标记的脑以矢状或水平朝向安装；使用与图面范围对应的低倍或高倍采集分支。
        parameters: 
          instrument: Ultramicroscope II, LaVision BioTec Laser Module
          camera: Andor Neo sCMOS; sensor pixel size 6.5 µm
          software: lmSpector v7.0.119
          orientation: sagittal or horizontal
          AVP_Cy2_excitation_as_reported: 488 nm
          SMA_Cy3_excitation_as_reported: 525/50 nm
          collagen_Cy5_excitation_as_reported: 639 nm diode laser
          emission_filters: 
            AVP_Cy2: 525/50 nm
            SMA_Cy3: 605/52 nm
            collagen_Cy5: 705/72 nm
          settings_cases: 
            [1] A124-P003-C01
            [2] A124-P003-C02
            [3] A124-P003-C03
          stitching: not required; FOV covers region of interest
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A124_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Sec16
            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-25793-z#Sec16
            checked_in_prior_source_revision: true
            prior_source_revision: 2026-10-08; see original snapshot/history
        missing_information: 
          [1] 原文把 SMA 激发写成 525/50 nm，按原样保留为报告设置，不擅自改成激光波长。6.5 µm 是相机像元，不是样本 voxel。装载介质、曝光和激光功率未报告。各样本仅使用实际标记通道，不把三标记配置加给全部双标记样本。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A124-P003-S02
        title: 导入与解剖区域定义
        action: 导入 Imaris，用 Surface 模块界定/遮罩脑区：SCN 根据 AVP，OVLT 和 OC 根据 collagen；SCN shell/core 根据 AVP 的存在/缺乏区分。
        parameters: 
          software: Imaris v9.5.1
          module: Surface
          SCN_marker: AVP
          OVLT_OC_marker: collagen
          shell_core_definition: presence/absence of AVP
          atlas_registration: not required; identified by immunostaining
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A124_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Sec17
            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-25793-z#Sec17
            checked_in_prior_source_revision: true
            prior_source_revision: 2026-10-08; see original snapshot/history
          [2]             source_id: F03
            path: A124_candidate/sources/supplementary_information.pdf
            locator: PDF p.2
            checked_in_prior_source_revision: true
            prior_source_revision: 2026-10-08; see original snapshot/history
        missing_information: 
          [1] 区域阈值、Surface 生成参数及手工编辑准则未报告。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [3]         step_id: A124-P003-S03
        title: 显示用通道遮罩
        action: 为显示强弱不同的信号，在 AVP 通道遮罩 PVN；在 collagen 通道遮罩腹侧 OC 的 pia；增强 SCN 信号通道并与去除 OC 信号的通道合并。SMA 通道遮罩腹侧 OC 信号以改善最大投影显示。
        parameters: 
          display_example: Supplementary Fig.2 raw versus optimized
          purpose: visualization of strong/weak signals and removal of selected background
          operation: masking and channel merging
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A124_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Sec17
            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-25793-z#Sec17
            checked_in_prior_source_revision: true
            prior_source_revision: 2026-10-08; see original snapshot/history
          [2]             source_id: F03
            path: A124_candidate/sources/supplementary_information.pdf
            locator: PDF p.3
            checked_in_prior_source_revision: true
            prior_source_revision: 2026-10-08; see original snapshot/history
        missing_information: 
          [1] 原文未给出增强数值或阈值；不把显示优化当作定量亮度校正或新增组织信号。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
  [2]     section_id: A124-P003-SEC02
    title: 描迹与光学重切
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A124-P003-S04
        title: 门静脉连接描迹
        action: 沿 collagen 标记血管描迹；Imaris 和 Vesselucida 按图面采用两种不同的已报告方法。
        parameters: 
          Imaris: manual Auto-depth method; Fig.2 and Supplementary Fig.3
          Vesselucida: Vesselucida 360 v2019.1.3; semi-manual user-guided directional kernel; Figs.3–4 and Supplementary Fig.4
          channel: collagen
          observer_check: 2 independent researchers reported same tracing results
        source_refs:

            prior_source_revision: 2026-10-08; see original snapshot/history
        missing_information: 
          [1] 未给出描迹容差、分支处理规则或数值一致性；该程序是血管图像描迹，不是活体示踪。
        legacy_rows: 
[]

        title: 光学重切与 MIP 展示
        action: 从同一光片体积生成按面板指定的三维视图、MIP 或光学重切片。显示厚度不替代采集 Z-step。
